assessments.omission_note: 未提及魏军最初坚守不战及蜀军粮尽是撤退主因的完整因果
assessments.reason: The accepted scene states that Kongming withdraws, but omits that Wei’s refusal to engage and Shu’s one-month grain limit directly cause the withdrawal. This removes an important motivation and causal link.
assessments.required_fix: Add that Wei initially refuses battle and that Shu’s dwindling supplies force Kongming to withdraw.

assessments.omission_note: 略去曹真等得知空营后的追悔，以及郝昭死后魏军调防等细节
assessments.reason: Cao Zhen’s regret and illness explain his decline, while the post-Hao Zhao reassignment establishes the military command and chronology leading into the later defense of Chang’an. These are more than ornamental details.
assessments.required_fix: Add Cao Zhen’s regret after discovering the empty camp, his resulting illness, and the reassignment of Guo Huai, Sun Li, and Zhang He to defend the routes around Chang’an after Hao Zhao’s death.
